screens.mentorLine: Saw you draft a post three times last night and not hit send. What were you going to say?

replyChips.text: I wanted it to land a certain way and I got in my head about it.

branches.honest: Yeah. That loop is real. The thing that gets me is when I catch myself writing for the version of me I want people to think I am. Like I'm auditioning for my own life.
branches.surface: Ha, not watching, just noticed. Can I ask though, what was the version of you in that post? Like who were you trying to be on the page?
branches.deflect: That's solid, just one thought. You redrafted it three times. Something about it mattered. Not a big deal is fine, but I don't buy it yet.
